title: 2024 HMMT February Guts Problem 19
statement: Let \(A_{1} A_{2} \ldots A_{19}\) be a regular nonadecagon. Lines \(A_{1} A_{5}\) and \(A_{3} A_{4}\) meet at \(X\). Compute \(\angle A_{7} X A_{5}\). Proposed by: Nithid Anchaleenukoon

solutions.text:
Inscribing the nondecagon in a circle, note that

\[\angle A_{3} X A_{5}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\widehat{A_{1} A_{3}}-\widehat{A_{4} A_{5}}\right)=\frac{1}{2} \widehat{A_{5} A_{3} A_{4}}=\angle A_{5} A_{3} X\]

Thus \(A_{5} X=A_{5} A_{3}=A_{5} A_{7}\), so

\[\begin{aligned}
\angle A_{7} X A_{5} & =90^{\circ}-\frac{1}{2} \angle X A_{5} A_{7}=\frac{1}{2} \angle A_{1} A_{5} A_{7} \\
& =\frac{1}{4} \widehat{A_{1} A_{8} A_{7}}=\frac{1}{4} \cdot \frac{13}{19} \cdot 360^{\circ}=\frac{1170^{\circ}}{19}
\end{aligned}\]
